game_profile_hint: Game profile: name, instructions for the agent, where to search
browser_empty_hint: The current chat from the overlay will appear here.
panel_empty_hint: New chat. Ask anything about the game.
agent_unavailable_see_chat: {agent} is unavailable — details in the chat
game_name_hint: If the window title doesn't look like the game's name, the agent will know which game it is.
game_instructions_placeholder:
For example:
no spoilers past chapter 3
I play as a mage
keep answers short
game_instructions_hint: The agent gets them in every chat of this game.
game_sources_placeholder:
Sites, one per line:
fextralife.com
wiki.example.org
game_sources_hint: The agent searches these sites first, and others only if they don't have the answer.
game_applies_next: Applies to the game's chats from the next question
game_no_chats: No chats for this game yet
model_menu_note: For this chat right away and for the next chats.
settings_only_on_pc: Settings open only on the PC where game-overlai runs.
settings_restart_needed: The agent, the proxy and the ports apply after the app restarts.
language_hint: Applies at once: pages, overlay, tray, notifications and the phone.
hotkeys_taken: Taken by another program: {keys}. Choose another combination.
hotkeys_hint: Click the field, then press the combination. Applies right after saving. Ctrl+Alt is the safest: games almost never use it. “Focus” moves the keyboard between the game and the open panel without closing it.
require_proxy: Don't connect to {agent} without a proxy
require_proxy_hint: If no proxy is found, such an agent won't start, and the app will wait until a proxy appears.
panel_hint: For games the panel hasn't been moved over yet. Its place, size and zoom over each game are remembered automatically. Panel zoom: Ctrl + mouse wheel or Ctrl +/− over the panel, Ctrl+0 returns the default zoom.
panel_capturable: Show the panel in screen recordings and streams
panel_capturable_hint: Off: Windows hides the panel from screenshots, recordings and streams (OBS, Discord, Win+Shift+S). On: it is visible when the screen or a window is captured. Game Capture in OBS takes frames from the game itself and never sees the panel, and game frames for the agent are always without the panel.
reset_panel_places_confirm: Forget where the panel was over each game?
frame_480: 480p — uses less of the limits, small text is harder to read
frames_hint: Frames saved in the history are always full size.
phone_settings_hint: The QR code and turning access on:
notify_when_hidden: Notify when an answer is ready while the panel is hidden
autostart_other: Starting with Windows is now set up for another copy: {path}
phone_only_on_pc: This page works only on the PC where game-overlai runs.
phone_intro: A phone on the same Wi-Fi network as this PC opens the same chat: questions, history, game frames. If a question is about the screen, the agent takes a frame of the game that is on this PC's screen.
lan_on: Access from the local network is on
lan_off: Access from the local network is off
lan_no_address: Couldn't find this PC's address in the local network. Connect the PC to the router (Wi-Fi or cable) and reload the page.
phone_scan: Point the phone's camera at the code and open the link. The phone will remember the sign-in.
interface_missing: The chosen interface “{adapter}” isn't there now (disabled or without an address); the code leads to the automatic one.
interface_not_local: This is a virtual, VPN or external address: a phone on the home Wi-Fi most likely won't open the chat through it.
reset_access_confirm: All phones will be signed out and will need to sign in again with the new code. Reset?
phone_hint_firewall: The first time, Windows asks whether to allow the app network access: allow it for private networks. Better not to turn access on in public networks (café, hotel).
phone_hint_private: If the phone doesn't open the page: check that it is on the same network and that Windows marks the network as private (Settings → Network & internet → Wi-Fi → network properties).
phone_hint_unencrypted: The connection isn't encrypted: turn access on only in your home network.
no_access_rescan: On the PC, open “Phone: QR code” in the game-overlai tray menu and scan the code again.
no_access_cookie: If it says “No access” again after that, check that the phone's browser doesn't block cookies.
err_hotkey_quick: The quick question hotkey isn't recognized: “{keys}”.
err_hotkeys_same: Each action needs its own hotkey.
err_proxy: Proxy: enter an address like http://127.0.0.1:10808.
err_panel_size: Panel size: width from 360 to 2000, height from 220 to 1600.
err_frame_height: Frame height for the agent: from 360 to 2160 (or “full window size”).
err_refusal: The model refused to answer this request.
err_max_tokens: The answer was cut off: the length limit was reached.
err_usage_limit: The subscription limit is used up, try again later.
err_no_connection: No connection to the model's servers. Check the internet or the proxy: by default the Windows system proxy is used, another one can be set in Settings → Network.
err_agent_restarted: the agent restarted during the answer
agent_needs_proxy: {agent} is set to work only through a proxy, and no proxy is found now. Turn on the system proxy and the agent will start by itself in a few seconds.
err_no_node: Node.js isn't found. Install Node.js LTS (nodejs.org) and restart the app.
err_no_npm: npm isn't found (it comes with Node.js). Reinstall Node.js and restart the app.
login_hint_claude: Sign in to Claude Code: open a terminal, run `claude` and the `/login` command.
login_hint_codex: Sign in to Codex in a terminal with `codex login`, then restart the app.
err_frame_over_limit: the {size} frame doesn't fit into the 5 MB limit
err_no_gpu: the graphics card is unavailable for capture
err_black_frame: the frame came out black: the game doesn't allow capturing it
err_game_no_size: the game window has no size
err_no_frame: the game gave no frame within a second
err_no_game: the game is unknown: open the overlay over the game with the hotkey
progress_memory_hint: The agent saves lasting facts about your progress (chapter, build, bosses beaten) and uses them in every chat of that game. You can see and fix them on the game's page.
progress_hint: What the agent remembers about your progress in this game. It adds and updates notes itself; you can fix or delete them.
progress_off: Progress memory is off in the settings: the agent doesn't see these notes.
progress_empty: Nothing yet. Tell the agent where you are and what you play as.
progress_add_placeholder: Add a fact, e.g. “Chapter 3, playing a mage”
widgets_hint: Cards pinned over the game window. Ask the agent to pin quest steps, a build, a checklist or a timer. Drag a card by its title, change its width by the corner; the corner button makes it see-through.
widgets_empty: No widgets for this game yet.
